messages:
incident-bot: P1 alert — service=inference-us-west, p95 latency > 1200ms, error rate +18% in the last 3m. Auto-escalation: opening incident workspace and notifying oncall. metrics: https://metrics.redwood.internal/r/inference-us-west | logs: https://logs.redwood.internal/q/5132109876

sarah: ack — oncall (sarah) here, joining war room. pulling up traces now.

bob: joining. created war room link: https://warroom.redwoodops/room/5132109876 — bob is taking incident owner unless someone else prefers.

jane: copying. I'll page infra and SRE threads, and draft initial customer comms. paging infra now -> @oncall-infra :phone:

support-bot: Paging sent to @oncall-infra (rotation: infra-night). ETA for ack: ~2m.

sarah: @bob if you take owner I can handle external comms and routing. Also can you drop the recent deploy id? want to check rollout windows.

bob: taking owner. recent deploy id: a1b2c3d4 (canary rolled 04:12 UTC). Suggest checking canary vs prod diff.

kai: adding context — we pushed a model-bundle update 15m before spike, also changed batching config. prefer to check model variant and revert batching change if correlated.

bob: running quick log collection:```bash
kubectl -n inference logs -l app=inference --since=15m | grep -i "error\|timeout" | tail -n 200
```

bob: collecting KV-cache stats and prefix hit rates now. will attach when ready.

jane: Draft for status page / customer notification (suggested):
"We are currently investigating elevated inference latency affecting a subset of requests in US-West. Our engineering team is actively investigating and has engaged SRE. Some customers may experience delays in responses. We will provide updates every 15 minutes or as significant progress is made. If you are experiencing production impact, please reply to this notification or open a support ticket."

ali: small edit: add "no data loss" and include contact alias. propose: "No data loss is expected. Contact: support@redwood.ai or reply to this status update."

jane: noted, updating draft and creating status incident: https://status.redwood.com/incidents/rdw-2026-153 — please review before publish.

sarah: Confirming oncall infra ack (via DM) and SRE pinged. infra said they'll be onsite in 3m. :thumbsup:

bob: quick mitigation plan: 1) scale inference pool x2 for critical routes 2) revert recent batching change on canary 3) if latency improves, roll to prod revert. Initiating scale now.

support-bot: Scale request submitted to autoscaler: action_id=scale-5132109876-1, target=+2 pods.

kai: if scale doesn't help we should fallback to smaller model variant for heavy routes (model-small fallback). prepping rollout plan.

jane: customer comms queued as "investigating" but holding publish until we confirm owner and initial mitigation in 10m.

bob: logs + KV stats attached to war room. early signal looks correlated to batching update in canary. reverting canary change now: `deployctl rollback deploy/a1b2c3d4 --to previous`

sarah: confirming: oncall handoff message sent to day team at 5132110400 (handoff note in war room).

incident-bot: Incident workspace created and linked to status incident. Next automated update scheduled in 15m. Incident owner: bob. War room: https://warroom.redwoodops/room/5132109876.

bob: will post next status when we have metric delta after revert. thanks team."
